verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me, because the LORD anointed me to bring good news to the humble. He sent me to bandage broken hearts, announce freedom to captives, and release to the people in chains,
to announce the year of the LORD’s favor and our God’s day of vengeance, to comfort everyone who’s grieving,

and to care for those who grieve in Zion. He sent me to give them a garland in place of ashes, oil of joy in place of mourning, and praise to wear in place of a heavy spirit. People will call them trees of righteousness, planted by the LORD so he’ll be glorified.
They’ll rebuild the ancient ruins. They’ll raise up places that used to be wrecked and fix cities that have been in ruins for generations.
Strangers will tend your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.
You’ll be called the LORD’s priests. People will call you the servants of our God. You’ll live on the wealth of the nations and take pride in their glory.
You’ll receive a double share in place of shame. In place of disgrace, they’ll celebrate their share. They’ll own twice as much in their own land, and their joy will last forever.
“I’m the LORD, and I love justice. I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I’ll faithfully give them what’s due and make a covenant with them that lasts forever.
Their children will be known among the nations, their descendants among the peoples. Everybody who sees them will know they’re the people the LORD blessed.”

I’ll celebrate with everything I’ve got in the LORD. My whole soul will be glad in my God. He dressed me in salvation and covered me with a robe of righteousness, like a groom putting on a garland and a bride putting on her jewels.
The earth makes new shoots grow, and a garden makes what you plant spring up. That’s how the Lord GOD will make righteousness and praise spring up in front of every nation.
